fact: Zanzibar's ZSSF, ZHSF, ZUPS, TASAF and MoCDGEC welfare programmes operate separate, independently developed information systems with no common identifier, and a unified Zanzibar Dynamic Social Registry is only proposed.
title: What would it take to establish a unified, dynamic social registry in support of poverty reduction in Zanzibar?
publisher: Zanzibar Research Centre for Socio-economic and Policy Analysis (ZRCP) / Oxford Policy Management DEEP
